title: Enterprise Procurement Test Strategy v1 — Rig Relay

existing_test_infrastructure.ci_pipeline: GitHub Actions: schema validation, static site renderer, CodeQL, release gate (advisory), build-and-upload with smoke tests

tests.description: Verify observability.jsonl never contains raw prompt text.
Verify observability.jsonl never contains raw model output text.
Verify observability.jsonl never contains API keys, tokens, or secrets.
Scan all artifact output paths for forbidden content patterns.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out visibly degrades adaptive/product-learning recommendations.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out degrades UX optimization feedback.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable receipt persistence. Receipts are enterprise audit evidence, not product telemetry.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable release-gate record generation.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable mutation receipt recording.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable schema validation record generation.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable export manifest generation.
Verify product-telemetry opt-out does not disable enterprise audit event recording. Audit evidence is mandatory in enterprise mode regardless of telemetry state.
Verify remote telemetry contribution setting disabled blocks remote bundle upload.
Verify disabling remote telemetry contribution does not disable local operational observability events.
Verify cockpit status indicators distinguish product-telemetry-enabled, remote-contribution-disabled, local-observability-degraded, and enterprise-evidence-unavailable states independently.
Verify no remote bundle upload without explicit consent scopes for remote telemetry contribution.
Validate all procurement audit artifacts against their schemas.
Validate control mapping artifact against its schema.
Validate data inventory artifact against its schema.
Verify all evidence pack artifact schemas are consistent and complete.
Verify evidence pack command generates all expected artifacts.
Verify no forbidden content in generated evidence pack.
Generate evidence pack from actual repo state and validate.
Verify provider registry permissions match documented capability matrix.
Verify GitHub App permission posture artifact matches actual token scopes.
Verify projection payloads never contain auth tokens.
Verify projection payloads never contain raw file contents.
Verify all projection fields comply with content-light doctrine.

proposed_test_suites.theme: WebSocket Auth and Frontend Rendering Safety

tests.description: Verify WebSocket auth token never appears in bridge logs.
Verify frontend uses textContent, not innerHTML, for untrusted content.
Verify frontend code never uses eval(), new Function(), or dynamic code execution.
Verify no auth tokens in localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB.
Scan generated HTML for absolute file paths from build machine.
Verify no unexpected script tags in generated HTML.
Scan generated HTML for token-like strings (API key patterns).
Verify all content fields are HTML-escaped in generated pages.
Verify release manifest is generated and schema-valid.
Verify release artifact checksums match actual artifacts.
Verify SLSA provenance attestation is generated for builds.
Verify SBOM generation produces valid SPDX JSON.
Verify pip-audit reports zero known vulnerabilities.
Verify no dependency has incompatible license with AGPL-3.0.
Verify agents cannot overwrite pre-existing dirty files.
Verify dangerous bash patterns are detected and blocked.
Verify bash commands are rerouted to safer tools when applicable.
Verify tools cannot read identity/token/config paths.
Verify 28 sensitive environment variables are stripped before subprocess.
Verify debug bundles never contain raw prompts.
Verify debug bundles never contain secrets or tokens.
Verify debug bundles never contain raw file contents.
Verify debug bundle creation → quarantine → review → share workflow.
Verify OAuth tokens never appear in any telemetry event.
Verify identity/account data never appears in derived datasets.
Verify tokens are stored encrypted or via OS keychain, not plaintext.
Verify Alembic migrations apply and rollback cleanly.
Verify JSONL → Postgres → JSONL round-trip produces identical data.
Verify DuckDB and Postgres analytical queries produce identical results.
Verify enterprise config validation rejects malformed policies.
Verify RBAC model prevents unauthorized mutations.
Verify tenants cannot access each other's data.

test_classification_taxonomy.unit: Tests a single function/class in isolation. No I/O, no network, no filesystem.
test_classification_taxonomy.contract: Tests a boundary contract: schema validation, API contract, protocol compliance.
test_classification_taxonomy.integration: Tests multiple components working together. May use real filesystem or mock services.
test_classification_taxonomy.e2e: Full end-to-end test through multiple subsystems.
test_classification_taxonomy.real_artifact: Uses real file artifacts from the repository (not generated test doubles).
test_classification_taxonomy.adversarial: Tests security boundaries with malicious or malformed inputs.
test_classification_taxonomy.sabotage: Tests resilience against corruption, injection, or deliberate misuse.
test_classification_taxonomy.concurrency: Tests behavior under concurrent or parallel execution.
test_classification_taxonomy.substrate: Tests storage, cache, or infrastructure substrate correctness.
